_note: 2_S06 'Panty Raid' — Burton's errand: climb the girls'-dorm lattice after dark, collect five, ah, unmentionables under the librarian's nose, and deliver the bundle back to him (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_S06-panty-raid.md). **2_S06b.DAT (the dorm interior, area 35) was never extracted** — the stealth-collect plays in the area-23 interior pocket already used by 1_G1/2_S05, and the five panty points + the librarian's post are invented inside it (marked; z from 1_G1_Diary). The signature **soft-fail eject loop** (spotted -> marched out -> the stage rebuilds, never a mission fail) is our spotter + stage-scoped retry: the librarian's spotted_by fail carries the fail_text as the bust read and retry:"stage" rebuilds the collect stage with already-collected items kept (the original keeps them too); the marched-out walk, the re-climb reset and the ambient-headmistress hookup (shared_ambient_npc_hook — she is owned by an area script, OPEN there) are documented compressions. v1 further simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-S06 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the lattice climb is a reach beat + fade hop (traversal pending, 1_G1 pattern); the prefect/jock gag, the shower/social-girl conversation beats and the steam effects are cut to two color NPCs (effect_spawn_at_points and conversation_beat_machine pending); the storage-door lock-behind is skipped (door_prop_control pending); the Beatrice freakout + fire-alarm panic cut (with 13 sprinkler effects) is one speech beat; the Eunice front-door ambush IS real (a one-member wave); the stage-3 headmistress spawn/catch (+200 punishment, not a mission fail) is skipped (punishment system owns busts, OPEN); hitting girls (+5 punishment + flee) is skipped. SMissPass 2_S06 is a debug helper only (VERIFIED) — no reward. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
